title: Jev research articles: explicit we-do-this-for-you-at-scale closings
description: Ryan, 2026-09-26, on /blog/fine-tuning-jev/: articles like this need to be a lot more explicit that Anthus can do this for you, at scale, with years of experience doing it. First pass: a bespoke closing section on fine-tuning-jev that reconciles the small repo demo with the production loop Anthus has run for years on Plexus; a more explicit shared engage box; and the client-acquisition tag on the Jev series so the box renders on each. Follow-up: bespoke closings on the other Jev articles in the same shape.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Ryan, 2026-09-26: each research page needs to be a converting landing page for a social post about it, especially the Jev pieces. Done across nine articles (fine-tuning-jev by hand, then one-word-test, encoding-prejudice, can-you-fix-it, jev-vs-laya, can-you-trust-jev-confidence, distilling-jev-into-a-classifier, jev-useful-decisions, decision-models-are-not-calculators via three parallel passes). Each now has: the finding in the first two paragraphs, the third-way offer adapted to the technique it proves, two or three body tie-ins to the production loop (scorecards, approval gate, per-slice gates, confidence routing, audit trail), and a closing section naming the technique, linking the case study, Plexus, and /engage. Checked: no stale durations, no page self-references, client name only as a link target, one contrast per piece. Content submodule commit e8d52bf. Build running; site pin follows.
